info.name: PyTorch FOMO object detection (ExecuTorch)
info.description: A compact, fully-convolutional FOMO-style object detector in PyTorch. Trains on Edge Impulse bounding-box data by converting boxes to a centroid segmentation grid, and exports an ONNX model (FOMO output layer) for the platform plus an optional ExecuTorch .pte program.

parameters.name: Number of training epochs
parameters.help: Number of passes over the training set.

parameters.name: Learning rate
parameters.help: Learning rate for the Adam optimizer.

parameters.name: Batch size
parameters.help: Number of samples per gradient update.

parameters.name: Object weight
parameters.help: Loss weight applied to foreground (object) grid cells relative to background. FOMO grids are dominated by background, so a high weight helps the model focus on objects.

parameters.name: Export ExecuTorch .pte
parameters.help: Also export an ExecuTorch program (model.pte) alongside the ONNX model. The .pte is not used by the Edge Impulse SDK but is handy for native PyTorch/ExecuTorch deployment.
